thread_extension: How fast? Benchmarked on an M1 MacBook Air: 38ms to render a 10k-line diff. delta and difftastic choke on monorepo-scale changes. termdiff doesn't.
Setup is one line. It respects core.pager and your existing git aliases. No config file. No wrapper scripts. Just install and it works.
Word-level highlighting, not just intra-line color. Navigate hunks with single keystrokes. Packaged in Homebrew core. {APP_URL}
alt_variants: Your git pager is lying to you. termdiff renders 10,000 lines side-by-side in 38ms — word-level, zero config, single binary. {APP_URL}
Monorepo diffs shouldn't be unreadable. termdiff: side-by-side, word-level highlighting, 38ms on a 10k-line diff. MIT. {APP_URL}
